scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npm run prestart && npm run start
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:integration: cd backend && npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm ci && cd ../frontend && npm ci && cd ../e2e && npm ci
scripts.clean: cd backend && npm run clean && cd ../frontend && rm -rf dist
